columns.name: principal_type
columns.description: The kind of principal receiving access: account, group, or anonymous.

columns.name: principal_id
columns.description: The account or group identifier. Null only for the anonymous principal.

columns.name: access_level
columns.description: The standard access level: viewer, commenter, contributor, editor, or manager.

columns.name: resource_type
columns.description: The resource scope: repository, directory, file, table, or row.

columns.name: directory_id
columns.description: The stable directory identifier for a directory grant.

columns.name: file_id
columns.description: The stable file identifier for file, table, and row grants.

columns.name: schema_key
columns.description: The schema key for table and row grants.

columns.name: row_pk
columns.description: The canonical primary-key tuple for a row grant.
